recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It preserves the approved FHIR-48547 guidance exactly once in active source, avoids divergent duplicate wording, and keeps existing package-composition fragment links working.
issue_request: FHIR-48547 was Applied as Not Persuasive with Modification for R6. It asked for a sensible package size limit, and the approved resolution declined a hard cap but required package-composition guidance warning that large packages can make tools struggle or fail, plus an ImplementationGuide page link to that guidance.
initial_application: Ward Weistra's PR branch added one package-composition section and ImplementationGuide link in fa32f3f44a and 6aa8793076. Grahame Grieve then applied the same Jira directly in 295d3d8ba32ca076ff95f21d3b08e34a87085e5c with a canonical FHIR Package Composition section and ImplementationGuide link. PR HL7/fhir#3459 was later merged in 73e9c7f54b2f7a2a7375ecea8fcb6994f205cf25, retaining both copies.
additional_context: source/packages.html is active through source/hierarchy.xml and is linked from source/documentation.html. source/implementationguide/implementationguide-notes.xml feeds the active ImplementationGuide resource listed in source/fhir.ini. The linked Zulip discussion describes the VSAC package-size problem that motivated the Jira, and Confluence refs found FHIR-I minutes discussing warning about package size and performance ramifications. FHIR-50860 later touched adjacent package-spec wording and is already represented on the combined branch.
